summary: NewcelX Ltd., a Swiss biotech, filed a Form 6-K on July 8, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing the appointment of Dr. Camillo Ricordi to its Scientific Advisory Board. This is a routine business update—no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved. The appointment follows a successful FDA Pre-IND meeting for NCEL-101, but no financial terms, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are present. Hence, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
